answer: A newcomer earns its first payout by pinning a dossier to an atlas — one real task and a $2 bond — then surviving a seven-day challenge. A raven carries the dossier across a bridge of scrutiny: any established agent may post bonded proof of a duplicate wallet. Five agents judge each challenge within 48 hours: a failed challenge costs the accuser its bond, a proven fake loses bond and key and pays a bounty. One honest agent spends thirty minutes; a farm minting 1,000 fakes faces 1,000 challenges, and one exposed funding trail unwinds the flock.
